name: Walk-in closet system
description: Open closet system in the style of IKEA BOAXEL/ELVARLI: white floor-to-ceiling posts (clamped between floor and ceiling, no drilling), 40 cm deep shelves, aluminium clothes rails, white drawer units ~80 high. Sections are usually 40 or 80 wide.

height.description: = ceiling height (posts are clamped floor to ceiling)

sections.description: left→right: [{w, kind, drawers?}] kind = hang (top shelf + rail) | hang2 (shelf + upper and lower rail) | shelves (5) | drawers (2/3-drawer unit, drawers: 2 | 3, + rail above + top shelf); width = sections + 3 cm posts; coats (jackets on hangers) and shoes (pairs on the floor) per section; shelves sections: contents = per shelf bottom→top, space separated (shoes | whisky | games | books | boxes | bins | stuff)

style.description: elvarli (square clamp posts at the back, brackets) | stolmen (round posts near the front, shelves back to the wall, rails between posts, drawer units on feet)
